entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a couple of weeks ago. It seems to be having some issues.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me more about the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with how it works?

It's definitely a technical problem. The device is just not working correctly. It constantly won't sync with the VeloFit app on my phone. I've tried unpairing it, restarting my phone, everything the manual says. I feel like the unit I received is broken.
I see. So you believe the sensor itself is defective?

That's right. I'm pretty sure it's defective. I'm outside the 10-day window I saw on the new policy, so I can't just send it back, but I'm not sure what to do. Would it be possible to get a partial credit or maybe a discount code to order a new one? I'm willing to work with you on a solution.

I appreciate that. Let me just pull up your order information and double-check our policy for that specific item. One moment, please... Okay, I have your order here. It looks like you received it 18 days ago.

Alright, and looking at the knowledge base here... it says that for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 18, you're well within that window for a full refund.
Oh, really? I thought I read something about a shorter window. 90 days is great. So I can just return it?

Absolutely. Since you believe the item is defective, we can certainly process a full return. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label for you right now, and I'll send it to the email we have on file. Is that okay?
That's fantastic! Thank you so much, Isaac. That's a perfect solution. I really appreciate your help.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
